tasks.request: Construir app Android nativa Antigravity apuntando a https://antigravity.google.com/remote con estética Antigravity, sesión persistente, notificaciones nativas y compilación de APK validada en emulador con Anvil
tasks.summary: Built native Kotlin + Jetpack Compose Android app 'Antigravity' for https://antigravity.google.com/remote with Antigravity dark/cosmic styling & splash animation, persistent CookieManager session + Chrome-compatible UA for Google Sign-In, native Android notification bridge, collapsible floating dock, Settings bottom sheet, offline recovery, unit tests, compiled Antigravity.apk, and verified live on Centinela_API35 emulator with anvil qa.
